text_block_list.text:
Today's training menu with Gold City was 
all finished, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Is it okay if I stay behind 
a bit longer after this to train?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
About my modeling gig—looks like tomorrow 
morning's shoot got canceled.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to get some solid training 
in at times like this. Come on, what do 
you say?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yes! I knew you'd say that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So people don't dismiss this as just a 
model playing around, I've got to make 
proper use of whatever time I have.

Burning with ambition, Gold City threw 
herself into extra training until right 
before the dorm curfew.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: At least let me push myself a little!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, here I am saying it's 
"impossible" myself. ...Understood. I'll 
make sure to get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll head back to my room and check 
out some overseas fashionistas on 
Umastagram.
